## The Original App

This is the original app. It collects financial data for retail companies and
lets you compare one company against another, or against the segment it
belongs to. There is no AI anywhere in this version.

[FIT Retail Index (non-AI)](https://calvinw.github.io/BusMgmtBenchmarks/)

Behind the companies is a **DoltHub database** holding all of that financial
data, and the web app reads the companies and their numbers directly from it.

[BusMgmtBenchmarks on DoltHub](https://www.dolthub.com/repositories/calvinw/BusMgmtBenchmarks)

## The Same App, With an LLM

This is the same app with an **LLM Chat** added.

[FIT Retail Index (AI version)](https://calvinw.github.io/llm-chat-bus-dev/)

Two things are new:

- The chat can reach **the same DoltHub database** the original app uses, so
  the LLM can query the company data itself.
- With some local tools, the AI can also see **the state of the menus** on the
  company to company page.

Together these let the AI **curate** examples for you: it picks companies worth
comparing, sets the menus, and shows you the result.
